_: The app picker's list, in display order. Who sees an app is READ from that app's own allowlist (gate.file, relative to ~/apps) every time the kit builds, so the picker can never offer an app its gate would refuse. The gates themselves are unchanged and stay the real security; the picker only hides links. An app with no readable gate declares `who` instead and says why in `gate_note`.

apps.name: Ops
apps.gate_note: Cloudflare Access plus the People page in Ops (D1). Neither is a file, so the picker offers Ops to every @groundbreakermarketing.com address; Ops itself still refuses anyone not on its People page.
